continuous.release_gate: No cumulative fence delay. Retain individual increases and interpret using matched starts.

control_scope.matched_depth_load_scope: Boot establishes valid uniform D24. The LOAD trials exercise regular full rows of that valid attachment through the ordinary pass command, plus full D24 and RGB565 comparisons afterwards. The independent natural preconditions instead establish valid, nonuniform D24 with the normal pass path, and account for the whole seed-plus-update history. Their individual B timing is phase-sensitive.
control_scope.copy_seed_scope: COPY controls seed the same nonuniform RGB565 with ordinary passes and depth DISCARD, leaving full shared D24 at its independently checked boot value. Patterned full-screen still checks displayed front via PRESENT. Pitched heap COPY includes the first-use uploaded wire stream.
control_scope.mixed_depth_seed_scope: Matched tests issue lane-varying depth before the original comparison rectangles within one pass. The original separate legal seed and LOAD (split into at most two references per seed tile list) remain in natural_seed_histories.
control_scope.dirty_skip_matched_seed_scope: Both histories use the original SDK depth CLEAR/DISCARD passes and RGB565 STORE. The matched A uses exact per-tile re-anchoring of the source triangle planes. The natural A+B uses the original packet paths and is additionally verified as an unchanged control.

depth_and_scanout_profile.scanout_scope: Active refill occupancy excludes the intentional final FIFO drain after the full frame has already been requested. Delays are measured through command grant and accepted first response word.
